This article also seeks to define types of signs, identify sign restrictions and to protect the safety and general welfare of the public within Miami Township by encouraging compatibility between the design and functional nature of the sign and its location within the physical e nvironment, thus reducing the propensity for traffic accidents and personal hazards caused by distractions, sight obstructions, and unsafe structures.
